title: Time and Days of the Week

001: Ivan, do you know what time it is?
It's about half past three right now.
It's already that late? I thought it was only two o'clock.
Time flies when you have a lot to do.
That's true. I need to make it to the store before five.
Then you'd better hurry, or you won't make it.
002: Dmitry, what time is our meeting tomorrow?
At ten in the morning, as usual.
Great. And which room is it in?
In room three hundred five, on the third floor.
Got it. I'll come a little early.
Good, I'll try not to be late either.
003: Sergey, are you free on Saturday evening?
On Saturday? Unfortunately, I'm busy until six.
Then let's meet at seven by the park.
Deal. At seven at the main entrance.
004: Olga, what day of the week is it today?
I got totally confused because of the holidays.
Yeah, it's easy to forget after the weekend.
So classes start in two days.
That's right, on Friday we have our first class.
005: Maria, could you tell me what time it is?
It's a quarter to six right now.
Thanks. I promised to call my mom at six.
Then you still have fifteen minutes.
Yes, just enough time to finish my errands.
Good thing you remembered about the call.
006: Alexey, what time does the library open on Monday?
At nine in the morning, and it closes at eight in the evening.
And does it work on the weekends?
On Saturday until five, and on Sunday it's closed.
That's a shame. I need to return my books this week.
Then you'd better come on a weekday.
007: Elena, do you know when the concert starts?
I think at seven in the evening.
And what time did we agree to meet?
We decided to meet at half past six.
Great. We'll have plenty of time to walk there.
Yeah, we can even grab a coffee before it starts.
008: Ivan, do you remember that we have to get up early tomorrow?
Yes, I need to be at the train station at eight.
And what time are you planning to leave the house?
I think at seven fifteen, so I don't have to rush.
Good. I'll set my alarm for six.
Great idea. Better not to risk it.
009: Yes, I've already started getting ready for the celebration.
And what time will the party start?
Come by six in the evening, we'll be waiting.
010: Dmitry, do you know when the post office closes?
Usually at seven, but on Friday at six.
Yes, today is Thursday, so you'll make it before seven.
Great. I need to send a package.
Then don't put it off, better to go now.
